title: Lift Access Allowed on the Terms a Snowsports School Household's Stay Is Priced On
content:
A household staying with the collective is allowed lift access on the terms its stay is priced on. The allowance is read from the state of the household's Resort Lodging reservation and the rate plan that reservation is priced on.

Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state priced on the holiday window, the holiday stay points are allowed, and they stand at 20 points. Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state priced on the peak window, the peak stay points are allowed, and they stand at 10 points. Where the household holds no Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state, no stay points are allowed, and the allowance stands at 0 points.

## Reservation state, window and points

| Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state | Rate window the reservation is priced on | Points allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | holiday | 20 |
| yes | peak | 10 |
| yes | any other window | 0 |
| no | any window | 0 |

Both facts are read from the household's Resort Lodging records, and a reservation standing in a state other than confirmed allows no points whatever window it is priced on.

These points are a reduction in percentage points on the lift access add-on for a Snowsports School booking. They are combined with the other reductions allowed on that add-on into one total in percentage points, and the add-on figure is reduced once by that total rather than by each reduction in turn.

## Points of judgement in illustration

- A household whose confirmed Resort Lodging reservation is priced on the holiday window is allowed 20 points on the lift access add-on of its Snowsports School booking; on a figure of 400.00 USD those points are worth 80.00 USD.
- The same household, its reservation priced on the peak window, is allowed 10 points, worth 40.00 USD on that figure.
- A household whose Resort Lodging reservation has not reached the confirmed state is allowed nothing on this count.
